newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian bourse sees higher 1997 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian bourse sees higher 1997 turnover.

text.p: The Nigerian stock exchange said on Wednesday it expected its turnover to hit 10 billion naira ($120 million) by the end of this year from seven billion naira last year.
"Turnover between January and June has touched five billion naira," head of research department Rasaki Oladejo said.
The 1996 turnover was a big improvement from just about two billion naira in 1995.
Traders said the sharp increase last year was evidence that the market had begun to reap the rewards of deregulation.
Oladejo said turnover was boosted with the inauguration of an automated clearing and settlement system in April this year.
The automated clearing system had allowed transparency and eliminated settlement problems which had dampened foreign investor enthusiasm.
